preemption.details: Texas enacted statewide preemption for knife laws effective September 1, 2015 (HB 905). Municipalities cannot adopt or enforce ordinances that are more restrictive than state law regarding knives.

open_carry.details: Open carry of knives, including large knives ('location-restricted knives' with blades over 5.5 inches), is generally legal in Texas as of September 1, 2017 (HB 1935). Location-restricted knives may not be carried in certain locations.

concealed_carry.details: Concealed carry of knives is legal in Texas, including knives with blades over 5.5 inches. Location-restricted knives (blades over 5.5 inches) cannot be carried in certain locations regardless of carry method.

blade_length.details: Texas does not have a general blade length limit. However, knives with blades over 5.5 inches are classified as 'location-restricted knives' and may not be carried in certain locations (schools, bars, sporting events, etc.).

switchblade.details: Switchblades are legal in Texas. The 2013 revision of Texas knife law (HB 1862) removed switchblades from the list of prohibited weapons.

automatic.details: Automatic knives are legal in Texas. They may be carried openly or concealed. If the blade exceeds 5.5 inches, the knife is subject to location restrictions.

assisted_opening.details: Assisted-opening knives are legal in Texas with no specific restrictions beyond the general location-restricted knife rules for blades over 5.5 inches.

ballistic_knife.details: Ballistic knives are prohibited under federal law. Texas does not specifically list them as an illegal knife, but federal law (15 U.S.C. § 1245) prohibits possession and sale.

restricted_locations.summary: Schools, polling places, courts, racetracks, bars (51% establishments), sporting events, correctional facilities, hospitals, amusement parks, and churches.
restricted_locations.details: Location-restricted knives (blades over 5.5 inches) may not be carried in the locations listed in Tex. Penal Code § 46.03 and § 46.035. Regular knives (blades 5.5 inches or less) are generally permitted in these locations.

statutes.title: Unlawful carry of handgun or location-restricted knife
